slots.sentence: “The recent decisions to shutter nearly complete offshore wind projects and to pay Total Energies hundreds of millions of dollars to renounce wind leases are an assault on logic and the American taxpayer,” he added, referencing the administration’s announcement earlier this year that it would reimburse a French energy company nearly $1bn to forgo plans to build windfarms off the US east coast.
